entered.description: true when it used the month's entered customer counts or headcount (rev 0.161).

undefined.description: Why it has no value, in words; never shown as 0 (FR-KPI-03).
examples: no subscription data: enter the month's customer counts

value.description: The figure, rounded by RND-KPI: an amount in the base currency as a decimal string, a percentage, ratio, number of months or days to one decimal, or a whole count. Left out when the KPI has words or no value.

words.description: Words that stand for the figure, such as Not burning for the runway when the average net burn is zero or less.
